description: Defines template classes FixedData and FixedDataIter for managing fixed data points and their iteration, including range checking, iterator operations, and data access methods.

classes.name: FixedData
classes.description: Template class for managing a fixed set of data points with range and extrapolation options.

classes.name: FixedDataIter
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing FixedData objects.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Access data at index with optional range checking based on extrapolation setting.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Access data at index with extrapolation allowed.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Gets previous data point relative to current.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Gets next data point relative to current.
